recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型、核摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍帶細顆粒的單核球與前單核球，夾雜小淋巴球、有核紅血球與顆粒球前驅細胞，呈現骨髓單核球系增生而原始細胞未成片，符合 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with increased monocytic cells
Monocytes and promonocytes with folded, indented or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant grey-blue finely granular cytoplasm
Occasional cells with delicate chromatin and nucleoli (blasts), not forming sheets
Admixed granulocytic precursors, small lymphocytes and dense erythroid precursors
Background red cells with rouleaux-free distribution
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular, mixed population with a conspicuous increase in monocytic cells, including monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm. Occasional blasts are present, admixed with maturing granulocytes, small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. There are no sheets of blasts. Findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a child with peripheral monocytosis, splenomegaly and a RAS-pathway mutation; blasts plus promonocytes should be enumerated to exclude AML.

ddx.vs: AML with monocytic differentiation shows >=20% monoblasts and promonocytes forming sheets with little maturing background.
CMML is morphologically similar but is an adult disease without the pediatric JMML genetic context.
Reactive monocytes are mature without promonocytes or blasts, and the disorder resolves with the underlying cause.
